mintAuthority.summary: Synthetix sUSD is an overcollateralized debt-pool stablecoin; both the legacy sUSD token and V3 Core Proxy are owned by a 4-of-7 Gnosis Safe with no timelock.

controls.label: sUSD token (Synthetix legacy proxy, target() pattern)
controls.capDescription: Minting is bounded by the protocol-owned debt pool issuance ratio (~200% post-SIP-420) across SNX/ETH/USDC collateral types.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,360,249, token uses Synthetix legacy target() pattern (not EIP-1967). owner() = 0xeB3107117FEAd7de89Cd14D463D340A2E6917769 (Gnosis Safe 4-of-7).

controls.label: Synthetix V3 Core Proxy
controls.capDescription: V3 minting is bounded by Synthetix debt-pool collateralization and market configuration, which the same governance Safe can update.

sources.label: Synthetix V3 Core Proxy on Etherscan

controls.evidence: At block 25,360,249, owner() = 0xeB3107117FEAd7de89Cd14D463D340A2E6917769 — same 4-of-7 Safe as sUSD token.

controls.label: Synthetix governance multisig (4-of-7 Gnosis Safe)
controls.evidence: On-chain getOwners()/getThreshold() at block 25,360,249 confirmed 4-of-7 Gnosis Safe v1.3.0, nonce 3334 (highly active). No timelock between Safe and contracts. Controls both legacy sUSD token and V3 Core Proxy.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,360,249: sUSD token owner() = V3 Core Proxy owner() = 0xeB3107117FEAd7de89Cd14D463D340A2E6917769 (Gnosis Safe v1.3.0, 4-of-7, nonce 3334, no modules). Full governance chain verified on-chain via getOwners()/getThreshold(). No timelock present. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the self-controlled Safe can raise collateralized issuance parameters without an independent timelock, reconciliation is not applicable to the on-chain CDP debt pool, and no supervisor or independent attestor is identified.
